record.reason: Autosparse uses an LLM to propose fusion groupings and legal dataflow orders inside a sparse-ML compiler for GCN/GraphSAGE workloads; the LLM is a search tool for sparse tensor scheduling, and there is no contribution to LLM inference, serving, or decoding.
record.title: LLM-Guided Autoscheduling for Large-Scale Sparse Machine Learning
